snippet.title: Pack my LunchBox — Official Game Trailer (Cozy Puzzle Game)
snippet.description:
Official trailer for "Pack my LunchBox" — a cozy and relaxing puzzle game where you assemble the perfect lunchboxes based on your customers' wishes! 🍱✨

Fluffy omelet or steamed rice? Cinnamon roll or vanilla cheesecake? Read the order cards carefully, manage preferences and exclusions, and choose the perfect combination of main dishes, snacks, and drinks!

🎮 Play the Free Demo & Get the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4266040/Pack_my_LunchBox/
🚀 OUT NOW!
🌟 Explore our full collection: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45978844

Game Features:
🍎 Over a hundred cute and delicious food items;
🧠 Relaxing logic puzzles that test your attention to detail;
🎨 Charming hand-drawn art style with a cozy aesthetic;
💖 The perfect gameplay to unwind after a long day.

Subscribe for more updates, trailers, and upcoming cozy releases!
📬 Contact us: owlshowls.steam@gmail.com
